run_GTestBreakOnFailureUnitTest: run the gtest break on failure unit test suite to verify seg-fault behavior on assertion failures
run_RunAndVerify: run the gtest break on failure test program and verify whether it generates a seg-fault
run_Run: run a subprocess command and return 1 if killed by a signal or 0 otherwise
test_testFlagOverridesEnvVar: test that the gtest_break_on_failure CLI flag overrides the GTEST_BREAK_ON_FAILURE environment variable
test_testBreakOnFailureOverridesThrowOnF: test that gtest_break_on_failure takes priority over gtest_throw_on_failure when both are enabled
